intro.title: Introduction to Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
intro.description: Welcome to a journey into the fascinating world of Physical AI and Humanoid Robotics. This book is designed for students, researchers, and engineers who are eager to understand and build intelligent robotic systems that interact with the physical world.

module1/nodes.title: Understanding ROS 2 Nodes
module1/nodes.description: In ROS 2, a node is an executable process that performs computations. It's the fundamental building block of any ROS 2 system, representing a single logical unit of computation. Nodes can be thought of as individual programs or processes that work together to form a robotic application.

module1/rclpy-basics.title: Controlling ROS 2 with Python using rclpy
module1/rclpy-basics.description: This chapter will teach you how to use the rclpy library to create ROS 2 nodes, publishers, and subscribers in Python.

module1/services.title: Understanding ROS 2 Services
module1/services.description: While ROS 2 topics provide a flexible publish/subscribe mechanism for continuous data streams, services offer a request/response communication pattern. This is ideal for situations where a node needs to send a request to another node and wait for a specific response.

module1/setup.title: Setting up your ROS 2 Environment
module1/setup.description: This chapter will guide you through the process of setting up a ROS 2 development environment.

module1/topics.title: Understanding ROS 2 Topics
module1/topics.description: Topics are the most common communication mechanism in ROS 2. They implement a publish/subscribe messaging pattern, allowing nodes to exchange data asynchronously.

module1/urdf-basics.title: Modeling a Simple Humanoid with URDF
module1/urdf-basics.description: This chapter will guide you through creating a simple humanoid robot model using URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) and visualizing it in RViz2.

module2/gazebo-digital-twin.title: Building a Basic Digital Twin in Gazebo
module2/gazebo-digital-twin.description: This chapter will guide you through creating a basic robot digital twin model in Gazebo, configuring its physics and collision properties, and attaching simulated sensors like LiDAR and IMU.

module2/physics-collision.title: Physics Simulation and Collision Modeling
module2/physics-collision.description: This chapter explores the fundamentals of physics simulation and collision modeling in the context of robot digital twins.

module2/sensor-sim.title: Sensor Simulation (LiDAR, Depth, IMU)
module2/sensor-sim.description: This chapter delves into the principles and techniques behind simulating common robot sensors like LiDAR, Depth cameras, and IMUs in virtual environments.

module2/setup-gazebo.title: Setting up ROS 2 and Gazebo for Digital Twin Simulation
module2/setup-gazebo.description: This chapter provides a foundational guide for setting up your development environment to work with ROS 2 and Gazebo for robot simulation. A robust setup is crucial for building and interacting with digital twins.

module2/setup-unity.title: Setting up Unity for Robotics
module2/setup-unity.description: Unity provides a powerful platform for 3D visualization, simulation, and human-robot interaction. This chapter guides you through setting up Unity for robotics development.

module2/unity-hri.title: Unity for Robot Visualization and Human-Robot Interaction
module2/unity-hri.description: Unity is a powerful platform for creating interactive 3D environments, making it ideal for visualizing robot digital twins and developing intuitive human-robot interfaces.

module3/isaac-ros-perception.title: Isaac ROS Fundamentals and Perception Modules
module3/isaac-ros-perception.description: This chapter explores NVIDIA Isaac ROS, a collection of hardware-accelerated packages for ROS 2 that enables high-performance AI perception for robots.

module3/isaac-ros-pipeline.title: Creating a Basic Perception Pipeline with Isaac ROS
module3/isaac-ros-pipeline.description: This chapter guides you through setting up a fundamental perception pipeline using NVIDIA Isaac ROS modules, and visualizing its output within Isaac Sim.

module3/isaac-sim-basics.title: Isaac Sim Basics and Photorealistic Simulation
module3/isaac-sim-basics.description: This chapter introduces NVIDIA Isaac Sim, a powerful platform for photorealistic robotic simulation and synthetic data generation.

module3/nav2-humanoid-isaac.title: Nav2 for Humanoids with Isaac Sim and VSLAM
module3/nav2-humanoid-isaac.description: This chapter explores how to integrate the ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) with Isaac Sim for autonomous navigation of humanoid robots, utilizing Visual SLAM (VSLAM) for localization.

module3/setup-isaac.title: Setting up Isaac Sim and Isaac ROS Environments
module3/setup-isaac.description: This chapter provides a foundational guide for setting up your development environment to work with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac ROS for advanced robotics simulation and AI-driven perception.

preface.title: Preface
preface.description: This book is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to Physical AI and Humanoid Robotics.
